title: The Necessary Weather
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Zephyrine Okonkwo, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
